Copied verbatim:
- proptest-regressions/arrangement.txt: six saved minimized failure seeds;
- README.md section "Pathfinding Algorithm Visualization", through the chord
  candidate diagram: retained as pathfinding-example.md.

cases.json is an adaptation under GPL-3.0-only:
- all thirteen distinct-string D4/G4 candidates from the worked example;
- the three distinct duplicate-pitch failures from the six saved seeds;
- string/fret choices for those duplicate-pitch tests are our fixed-tab adapter,
  not fingerings selected or approved by the upstream program.

Upstream generates string/fret arrangements; our planner takes fixed string/fret
positions and chooses left-hand fingers. The feasible booleans are our reviewed
expectations under our conservative four-finger model, not upstream labels.
They exclude spans greater than five frets and duplicate use of one string.

Tests preserve the original example's G3, rest, B3, D4/G4 sequence. They also
adapt the upstream input-preservation, distinct-string and deterministic-search
invariants. Equal pitches on distinct strings must retain separate identities.
The duplicate-pitch cases are not silently changed to sets or deduplicated.

The test adapter guitar-upstream-regressions.test.ts is marked GPL-3.0-only.
No Rust production implementation or dependency was imported into the app.
